transcript.text: Hi, the light in my Neff oven has stopped working (model B1ACE4HN0B). Oven works fine otherwise. Can I change the bulb myself and what bulb do I need?
What is the main thing the oven cooker is doing wrong?

Nothing really wrong apart from the interior light, it doesn't come on with any function. Heating, fan and display all work normally, no error codes. Just want to know if I can swap the bulb myself and which one I need.

Please be aware that if you smell gas at any point during this process, stop immediately and tell me straight away. I need to know what happens when you push and turn the knob: does it click or spark but not light, does it not click at all, or does it light and then go out when you let go of the knob?

It's an electric oven, so there's no gas and no knob to push and turn. Could you tell me which bulb I need and how to swap it? I'll switch it off at the cooker switch and let the oven cool down first.
That helps narrow things down. Is it just one burner, or all of them?
There are no burners, it's a built-in single electric oven with no hob. It's just the interior oven lamp that's out. Which bulb do I need, and how do I swap it?

Thanks for confirming that issue with the burners. Please ensure every gas knob is off and the burners are completely cold before starting. Only lift off the burner cap and crown; do not remove anything else or loosen any gas fittings. The usual cause is a cap sitting square, wet, or greasy after cleaning. Lift off the cap and crown, dry and clean them (and gently wipe the white igniter tip), then re-seat them so they sit flat. Was a cap out of place, wet or dirty (and is it sorted), or were they all seated, dry and clean?
